ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) dominance approximately 85% of surface area versus 15% low-intensity (black) boundary pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central mass; low-intensity black perimeter along trailing edge and peduncle junction. Notable isolated black focal spots (ellipsoidal) at the upper-left quadrant and distal right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant pixel-depth penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges; notable high-amplitude protrusion (peak) localized on the right lobe trailing edge approximately two-thirds from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of roughly circular dark and light pixel patterns on distal lobe tips; secondary cluster of small dark circular spots on the upper-left interior white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field, primarily diagonal orientations on the inner-left and central-right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization causing irregular pixel texture and volume at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and high-intensity specular glare on the far right lobe and bottom central peduncle area.
